description: Egyptian-dialect dictation test set for the voice accuracy gate (docs/VOICE_TRANSCRIPTION.md). Each entry is a phrase a business owner would dictate; expected_transcript is the exact text the STT must produce, expected_intent is the Slice 3 deterministic action that transcript must yield against the harness seed data (customers: Ahmed Sami / Ahmed Radwan / Layla Hassan / أحمد سامي / أحمد رضوان / ليلى حسن; products: Cable / Cable Pro / Notebook / كابل; invoices: ISS-1 / ISS-2 issued), or 'read' for a business question (no write intent) and 'none' for non-actionable speech. The harness registers deterministic fixture audio bytes per id; a real provider candidate replaces them with recorded clips and must produce the same intents. SPELLING NOTE (gate finding, 2026-11-26): transcripts here use the ه spellings (فاتوره/مسوده) because the shipped Slice 3 matcher does not in fact fold ة->ه (assistant_intent._fold_light looks the fold table up with .get() on a str.maketrans dict, whose keys are ordinals, so ة survives folding while the patterns are written with ه). A ة-spelled invoice command (the natural STT output) currently extracts no intent. Fixing the fold is an activation-slice follow-up; when it lands, restore ة spellings in this set and re-run the gate.
